description: The Google ADK weather agent traced by OpenInference's ADK instrumentation.
notes: openinference-instrumentation-google-adk 1.1.0 over google-adk 2.14.0. The runner sets GOOGLE_API_KEY, so the Gemini client uses the API-key path and does not probe the metadata server. Gemini.base_url is the mock. Cloud Trace export is started only by the ADK CLI server, which this scenario does not run. ADK_EXPERIMENTAL_TELEMETRY is false. ADK_TELEMETRY_SCHEMA_VERSION_OPT_IN is 1. ADK_CAPTURE_MESSAGE_CONTENT_IN_SPANS is true. GoogleADKInstrumentor is attached to the capture tracer provider and is the only scope. It suppresses invoke_agent and generate_content. The tree is invocation, then agent_run, then call_llm and execute_tool. call_llm and execute_tool keep gcp.vertex.agent.* and also carry OpenInference input, output, and llm attributes. Token counts match agent-tool. The user-agent inside llm.invocation_parameters includes the interpreter version. Event timestamps inside OpenInference output values come from set_time_provider, a clock that starts at 1767225590 and steps by one millisecond. Event ids come from set_id_provider, a counter of capture-N. The session id is session-1 and the user id is user-1.
